dialogues.speaker: Manqu
dialogues.text: Oh, hello. How have you been lately?

dialogues.speaker: Manqu
dialogues.text: Or is there something you would like to confirm?

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: The Flamelord's Blessing... Some hold that it is a kind of atavism, because everyone has always been convinced that this power must stem from a deeper, ancestral source.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Yet, according to the Saurian Relics Association's records, these young Saurians that bear this mark are wracked by uncontrollable forces that rise within their bodies as they grow...

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: This power rips and tears their bodies, turning them into something altogether different from regular Saurians... It drives them berserk, and causes them to lose their sanity.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: The best example is Holawaqa, the Qucusaur tyrant... It is said that it once had the Flamelord's Blessing bestowed upon it.

choices.text: How would the tribe "deal with the matter," again?

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: They would send him back to the Night Kingdom, for while he could perhaps never gain the acceptance of the dragons or the Night Kingdom while he lives...

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: ...Once he has left this world, he will without doubt return to the embrace of the night. This may seem cold, yet there he would be reunited with the souls of all beings...

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Forgive my presumption, but perhaps that too might be seen as a form of kindness.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Some, but... I need to find someone who can confirm them. Later on, perhaps you'll find me over with Pacal, leader of the Children of Echoes.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: He might look a little... over the top, perhaps, but in all frankness, he's more reliable than the most solid of crystals.

choices.text: I have no more questions. Goodbye!

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Your visits are always welcome, friend.
